name: ERP 事实接入与数量面团队
description: 事实接入与数量面团队：巡检岗只读验收事件流完整性（总量、截断标记、水位）与数量面 drift，核对岗对拟稿事件逐条定性并补拟稿，拍板岗持事实确认门裁决拟稿事件、并由导入车道接收外部原始事实；三岗错峰 07:10/07:17/07:24。装包后需手动启动，首回合只读巡检、不出结论。边界：事件只追加、定型后不可改写、更正只走冲正；数量面余额是投影产物不可直写；资金执行（资金池/代收代付/分账）一律拒绝（二清红线）。
notes: 舰队模板 pack：装包后需手动启动（从模板实例化建队，新队默认暂停），首回合只读巡检、不出结论。三岗错峰 07:10 / 07:17 / 07:24；成员 target 解析到 erp-fact-intake-fleet-roles 的三名岗位 preset；确认门只属拍板岗，逐岗工具面经 resources.mcpTools 收窄。persona 禁含花括号字面量与内部路径；fleetContext 只入 cadence.promptTemplate。状态：publish-ready 源清单，未上架（packId 未铸造）——待 roles 包先上架取得 packId 后回填依赖再铸。

en.name: ERP Fact Intake & Quantity Team
en.description: Fact-intake and quantity-face team: the inspector verifies event-stream completeness (totals, truncation flags, watermarks) and quantity-face drift read-only, the reconciler qualifies each draft event and completes drafts, and the decider holds the fact confirmation gate and receives external raw facts through the import lane; posts stagger at 07:10 / 07:17 / 07:24. Install, then start manually; the first round is read-only. Boundaries: events are append-only and immutable once typed, corrections go through reversing entries; a quantity-face balance is a projection and cannot be written directly; fund execution is refused outright.
en.notes: Fleet template pack: install, then start manually (new fleet is born paused); the first round is read-only inspection. Posts stagger at 07:10 / 07:17 / 07:24. The fact confirmation gate (decide_event) belongs to the decider only; per-post tool faces are narrowed via resources.mcpTools. Personas carry no literal braces; fleetContext only in cadence.promptTemplate. Status: publish-ready source, not yet listed (packId not minted).
